entries.title: Mission-Invariant Architecture Morphing (MIAM)
entries.summary: Application-level service-graph morphing with cryptographic epoch isolation and mission-domain state continuity. Appendix A of the paper is a reference claim set released as a defensive publication.

entries.title: Security Stack Engineering (SSE)
entries.summary: Layered architecture for governed security operations with explicit inputs, outputs, invariants, and assurance feedback.

entries.title: Impact Forecast Algorithm (IFA)
entries.summary: Bayesian-inspired method for updating material-impact probability using explicit evidence likelihood ratios.
